messages:
Sofia (CS): Heads up 5 HelioCare showing a steep embed spend bump this week. Packaging a short QBR slide for next Tue. Need quick triage: root cause, immediate mitigations we can ask them to apply, and a customer-friendly ask for a temporary credit buffer.
Ravi (CSM): Saw the alert in the dashboard. Their ingest pipeline kicked off a backfill on 2026-03-18 that ran with parallelism=16. That multiplied concurrent embed batches.
Marta (FinOps): From our cost view, embed-related routes are 71% of incremental spend over the last 48h. Projected monthly delta (if sustained) = ~$14.2k.
Liam (SE): Can you paste the top routes and per-route tokens? I want to confirm the concurrency pattern.
Sofia (CS): quick snippet from logs/heatmap:
```
route: /v1/embeddings/bulk_upload  tokens: +2.4M  calls: +9.8k  peak_concurrency: 12
route: /v1/embeddings/stream     tokens: +150k  calls: +1.2k  peak_concurrency: 2
route: /v1/chat/assistant         tokens: +60k   calls: +400   peak_concurrency: 1
```
Ravi (CSM): That bulk_upload route is the backfill job. They pushed a config change last week. I can ask HelioCare to pause the backfill for 24h while we propose mitigations.
Marta (FinOps): Short mitigations to propose in QBR and customer note: 1) pause backfill; 2) reduce job parallelism to 4; 3) enable per-route soft quota of X tokens/min; 4) temporary 20% credits buffer for 7 days.
Liam (SE): Engineering fixes: add an auto-throttle on tenant-scoped jobs, enable prefix caching for lookups, and recommend SDK default batch size 64 for uploads. Low-impact PR + doc update.
analytics-bot: Automated detection \u2014 anomaly at 2026-03-18T09:14Z for HelioCare: route /v1/embeddings/bulk_upload token-rate z=5.2. Alerts suppressed (legacy setting).
Sofia (CS): For the QBR slide we need: baseline weekly spend, 48h delta, projected monthly if unchanged, recommended mitigations with estimated $ savings for each. Marta can you backstop the numbers?
Marta (FinOps): Yes. I'll produce a 2-slide delta: current vs baseline, and scenario costs for parallelism=16 / 8 / 4. Expect by EOD Thu.
Ravi (CSM): I'll own the customer comms: propose pausing the backfill and request the 20% buffer while we implement throttles. Draft to share in this thread before sending.
Liam (SE): I'll open a PR for the SDK default + a lightweight admission-control proposal. PR + short impact note by tomorrow morning.
Sofia (CS): Ops asks: can we enable a temporary per-route alert for HelioCare specifically? If ops-bot can create it, great.
ops-bot: ops-bot triggered \u2014 created alert rule helio-care-embed-rate: notify #customer-success + #eng-runtime on threshold > 500k tokens/min sustained 5m for route /v1/embeddings/bulk_upload.
Sofia (CS): Nice. Action item recap: Ravi -> customer pause request + buffer ask; Marta -> slides with dollar deltas; Liam -> PR for SDK + admission control; Me (Sofia) -> add a 15-min pre-QBR triage on Mon.
Ravi (CSM): Draft customer note (w/ approachable language):
"Hi team, we noticed a large backfill that increased embed consumption. Could you pause the job for 24h while we apply throttles? We'll cover short-term credits to avoid disruption and run a quick optimization to reduce cost by ~40%"
Marta (FinOps): Also prepping a short playbook slide: "If embed burst: pause backfill, reduce parallelism, enable cache, request buffer."
Liam (SE): Quick config snippet we can recommend to customer: 
```
backfill:
  parallelism: 4
  batch_size: 64
  max_tokens_per_minute: 500000
```
Sofia (CS): Perfect. If anyone finds any other anomalies in the next 24h, drop them here. We'll fold new notes into the QBR deck. :white_check_mark:
